name: symbols-connector
description: Draw connecting lines from the symbol under the cursor to its definition and every reference.

symbolsConnector.enabled.description: Enable or disable the connector rendering.

symbolsConnector.autoTrigger.description: Resolve the symbol under the cursor as it moves. When off, resolve only via commands.

symbolsConnector.debounceMs.description: Delay in milliseconds before resolving after the cursor moves.

symbolsConnector.includeDeclaration.description: Also ask the language server for declarations (e.g. prototypes in C/C++ headers). Definitions always take part.

symbolsConnector.maxRelated.description: Maximum number of related positions to render at once.

symbolsConnector.editorLines.description: Draw connector lines inside the editor.

symbolsConnector.railSpacing.description: Column spacing between parallel rails. Only used when maxRailLanes is greater than 1.

symbolsConnector.maxRailLanes.description: How many parallel rails to use. Default 1 keeps every connector flush with the left edge of the text area; increase to fan them out to the right.

symbolsConnector.minRailColumn.description: Base column for the rails. 0 = left edge of the text area.

symbolsConnector.showIndexLabels.description: Show index labels: 0 = definition/declaration, the rest numbered in code order.

symbolsConnector.autoOpenGraph.description: Open the reference graph automatically after resolving.

symbolsConnector.previewFiles.description: Maximum number of files to read source lines from for the graph previews.

symbolsConnector.lineWidth.description: Line thickness in px (decimals allowed, e.g. 1.5), applied to rails and stubs.

symbolsConnector.markBorderRadius.description: Corner radius in px for the reference highlight box. Does not affect the connector lines.

symbolsConnector.palette.description: Line colours, assigned to references in order. Default is a single colour; add more to tell references apart by colour. Supports #RRGGBBAA / rgba().
